title: TEOS Session
description: Machine-readable contract for the smallest schedulable instructional event and sole canonical scheduling primitive. A Session never contains institution-specific dates, assigned times, or canonical Week or Day values.

session_id.description: Stable identity unique within the Session namespace and independent of all scheduling positions.

version.description: The version of this Session contract.

owner.description: The curriculum owner authoritative for this Session.

session_title.description: The human-readable title identifying the instructional event.

session_type.description: The canonical instructional mode of the Session.

duration.description: The positive estimated instructional duration, excluding breaks and preparation.

learning_objectives.description: Observable or assessable results for this Session.

competency_references.description: The non-empty collection of version-bound Competencies addressed by the Session.

description.description: Additional curriculum-owned context for the Session purpose.

mode_allocations.description: Explicit portions of the Session duration assigned to instructional modes.

mode.description: The instructional mode receiving this allocation.

duration.description: The duration allocated to the instructional mode.

required_resources.description: Required facilities, technology, consumables, services, or capabilities without local assignments.

required_instructor_materials.description: Curriculum-owned materials an instructor needs to prepare or conduct the Session.

required_student_materials.description: Curriculum-owned materials learners must receive or supply.

required_equipment.description: Required equipment or tool capabilities without room, inventory, or personnel assignments.

required_safety_controls.description: Safety controls required before or during the Session.

prerequisite_session_references.description: Session predecessors that must be completed before this Session.

dependent_session_references.description: Session successors whose sequencing or coordination depends on this Session.

prerequisite_competency_references.description: Version-bound Competencies that learners must satisfy before this Session.

notes.description: Curriculum-owned authoring or delivery guidance that carries no hidden requirement.

estimated_preparation_time.description: Estimated instructor preparation effort, distinct from instructional duration and staffing.

rendering_metadata.description: Bounded, presentation-neutral hints that do not contain layout or institutional branding.

audiences.description: Audience categories for which Session content is applicable.

display_label.description: A stable presentation-neutral display label that does not override the title.

available_sections.description: Stable identifiers for content sections available to renderers.

scheduling_constraints.description: Curriculum-owned grouping and continuity constraints consumed by a Scheduler without assigning a date.

may_span_occurrences.description: Whether the Session may be divided across multiple scheduled occurrences.

may_share_occurrence.description: Whether the Session may share one scheduled occurrence with another Session.

requires_uninterrupted_occurrence.description: Whether the Session must be allocated as one uninterrupted occurrence.

maintainer.description: The organization responsible for maintaining this Session.

revision_notes.description: A non-empty explanation of changes in this version.

lifecycle_status.description: The shared lifecycle state of the Session.

metadata.description: Non-authoritative authorship, revision, and provenance metadata.

learning_objectives.default: Perform the approved electrical safety verification process.

sessionDependency.title: Session Dependency
sessionDependency.description: A version-bound Session dependency with explicit scheduling semantics.

session_reference.description: The version-bound predecessor or successor Session.

relationship.description: The documented sequencing or coordination relationship, such as before, immediately before, same meeting, non-overlap, or evidence-gated. The architecture does not yet define a closed vocabulary.
